summary: Horizon Quantum Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the appointment of Peter Oey to its Board of Directors. Mr. Oey, CFO of Grab Holdings, will chair the Audit Committee and serve on the Compensation Committee, succeeding Danielle Lambert. The filing details Mr. Oey's extensive financial leadership background. No deal terms, shareholder vote, or special-situation event is described. This is a routine board composition update. For US filers, a similar event would be reported on Form 8-K Item 5.02. No risk-arb or special-situation angle is present.
